move: card rises, steps slide in, ring draws, number becomes tick, bar advances
how: A white card rises 60px from scale 0.96 and opacity 0 (expo.out 0.8s) on a light stage; a kicker and heading rise out of masks. Three step rows are then presented 1.5s apart from 14%: each slides in from x -30 with opacity 0 (expo.out 0.6s), its circular ring stroke draws with drawSVG 0 to 100% (power2.inOut 0.6s), the number badge turns blue and the digit scales to 0 while a checkmark path draws in (power2.out 0.35s), and the progress bar width jumps to the next third (expo.out 0.5s); the previous step dims to 0.55 opacity. A patched seek writes the 'n of 3 done' counter from time. At 92% the card lifts 60px and fades (expo.in 0.5s).
adapt: Replace the kicker, heading and three step titles/descriptions, the accent blue (#3a5bff) and card size; step count changes the bar fractions and cadence. Keep the 0.6s expo.out slide, 0.6s ring draw and 1.5s cadence.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the card, rows with SVG ring and tick paths, counter and bar inside el, and sets drawSVG 0% on rings and ticks. animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with steps at (1.0+i*1.5)/7 of D; the counter override of window.__fx.seek becomes .call() or a proxy tween on the timeline; DrawSVGPlugin must be registered.
caveats: counter is written by overriding window.__fx.seek, not on the timeline
animates width on the progress bar
